added.member: UI classes mix-blend-normal, mix-blend-add, mix-blend-screen, mix-blend-multiply
added.summary: A UI element and the particles it emits blend with what lies under them by its mix-blend class (normal, add, screen or multiply), down its subtree.

A node's haptic prop (tick, tap, thud, double, buzz, success, warning, error, or none to silence it) plays when it fires an interaction or sound cue other than hover; a pack's haptics table sets them per slot and event, falling back like sounds, scaled by the player's haptic strength.

A theme's effects (glow, pixel-burst, ink-splash …) and density (comfortable, touch …) compile into its pack's shadows, text shadows and control heights; the cartoon, fantasy, ink, minimal, pixel and storybook themes tune their Combat HUD with them.

fixed: MTSDF text fills by the median of its channels and strokes and glows by its true distance, so outlined and glowing UI text no longer shows seams at its corners.
The default pack's Hit.arc, Hold.fill.danger and Bar.trail slots name classes that exist (stroke-arc, bg-danger-fg, duration-trail delay-trail-hold).
